attributes.readMe:
# Meeting

## Summary
A meeting with `meetingType` (interview | one-on-one | standup | vendor-review), `date` (datetime), `duration` (DurationField), an optional linked `candidate`, `interviewers` (linksToMany Employee), an `interviewScore` (ScoreField) and markdown `notes`.

## Import
```ts
import { Meeting } from './meeting';
```

## Usage
Meetings linked to the tracker app feed its Calendar tab; interview-type meetings render as highlighted chips.

## Template Usage
Embedded view shows type, time, duration, candidate, and score.
